output.reason: The brief fits all the evidence I have: the D5 dryer has been running wet, Arnholt was only ever trialled on Press 7, and splay plus brittle latch cracks are typical moisture symptoms. Its breakdown by press, resin and dryer, plus the test drying Arnholt in a portable dryer, makes a convincing case, and the next steps are concrete. One caution: it may be too quick to say Arnholt itself arrives wetter, when storage in the north annex hasn't been ruled out.
